fields.statement: At 30479135, go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/^(run-start|run-start-queue|daemon-settings|daemon-pause|daemon-event-hook|stage-autonomy|testscript-root)$' passed all seven. git log main..HEAD shows none of the six listed scripts changed. runs-need-root is in force: requireProject is at internal/api/run.go:534 and request.go:103. root-daemon-lock belongs to another change set and is not built at this commit, so only runs-need-root could be checked as in force. Setup in cmd/rhiza/main_test.go writes $WORK/rhiza.toml ([projects.repo] path="repo") directly and sets $NOROOT to a temp dir outside any root. testscript-root.txtar asserts that root show in $WORK/repo prints project: repo, and that root show in $NOROOT fails with 'not inside a Rhiza root' and next: rhiza root init. A scratch build run in a folder outside any root exited with code 2 and the same message.
